The Special Hearing Division shall be under the direct control of the
Deputy Commissioner for Revenue Collection and Monitoring and
shall be composed of at least six (6) members to be selected from the
Law Divisions of paM, NAJA and MICP upon the recommendation of
the respective Division Chiefs thereat.
All cases shall be assigned to each member on a rotation basis.
The Special Team of Prosecutors shall be directly under the Deputy
Commissioner for Intelligence and Enforcement Group who shall be
composed of as many members depending upon the volume of work
and the discretion of the said Deputy Commissioner.
The (Special Team of Prosecutors) shall be selected from the
